title: A new upper bound for the irrationality exponent of $ζ(2)$
summary: We prove that the irrationality exponent of $ζ(2)=π^2/6$ satisfies $μ(ζ(2))<5.0193784$. The best published bound is 5.095412 (Zudilin, 2014); a bound 5.0495243 with a machine-checked proof was made public in September 2026 by J. Kleid. We use Zudilin's two hypergeometric constructions at a new choice of parameters.
